visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged Asian male with short black hair and glasses stands centrally in front of a dark blue background. He wears a black button-down shirt and holds a small black clicker in his hands. To his left, a cartoonish Santa Claus figure with sunglasses and a red suit is visible. To his right, a green conical object resembling a simplified Christmas tree and a small golden gift box with a white ribbon are placed on a green surface. The lighting is bright and even, characteristic of a professional studio setting. (2) The scene shifts to a split-screen layout. The upper half displays a modern office interior with large floor-to-ceiling windows providing a clear view of a densely populated city with skyscrapers under a clear blue sky. A potted plant stands near the window. The lower half continues to show the man from the previous phase, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. (3) The video returns to the full-screen view of the man in the studio setting. He uses his hands to make expressive gestures, pointing and moving them to emphasize his points. The background elements remain unchanged. (4) A series of seven photographic panels appear, labeled A through G. These panels show clear, transparent rectangular frames held in various outdoor and indoor environments, including mountain views, academic buildings, and gardens. The panels appear to be transparent but are shown to have insulating properties in certain contexts. (5) An animated diagram appears showing molecular structures. It features a tan-colored branching skeletal structure labeled 'Polysiloxane' and a blue circular micelle structure labeled 'Surfactant'. The background is a clean white. (6) A 3D scientific visualization of a porous material is shown. The structure is golden-brown and composed of interconnected tubular networks. A scale bar at the bottom indicates a size of 10 nm. (7) A scientific graph is displayed, showing a curve of 'Transmittance (%)' over 'Wavelength (μm)'. It includes a highlighted region for the solar spectrum and a blackbody thermal receiver. The graph is labeled with the term 'MOCHI'.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 泛糰提問蒐集中就在會員專屬貼文. (2) [Slogan]: 不可思議！超隔熱的硬空氣. (3) [Subtitle]: 科學家剛剛發明了一種「固態空氣」. (4) [Subtitle]: 讓空氣頓時凝結你也會 你厲害 因為這真有用. (5) [Subtitle]: 根據統計 全球建築物消耗了 40% 的能源. (6) [Subtitle]: 而窗戶就是那個在冬天放生暖氣 在夏天迎進熱浪的內鬼. (7) [Subtitle]: 過去科學家試過用「氣凝膠」來隔熱. (8) [Subtitle]: 但因為內部結構太混亂 光線穿過去會散射 看起來霧霧的 所以人稱白色恐怖 啊不是 是罩霧 tà-bōng, Frozen Smoke. (9) [Subtitle]: 但現在科羅拉多大學波德分校的物理學家 在《Science》期刊上發表了一種新材料. (10) [Subtitle]: Mesoporous Optically Clear Heat Insulator 中文翻譯就是「介孔光學透明隔熱材料」 縮寫叫 MOCHI 對 就是麻糍 muâ-tsî. (11) [Subtitle]: 這不是這個團隊第一次挑戰「透明隔熱」這個聖杯了 通訊作者 伊凡．I．斯馬柳赫 (Ivan Smalyukh) 的實驗室. (12) [Subtitle]: 之前就做過纖維素氣凝膠 但薄薄一張還行 一旦變厚 還是會因為結構混亂 變得像白內障一樣霧霧的. (13) [Subtitle]: 為了打破「越厚越霧」的魔咒 他們開發了一種精密的「分子翻模」工程 強迫材料乖乖排隊. (14) [Subtitle]: 既然要翻模 科學家需要一個模具 來製造出奈米級的孔洞. (15) [Subtitle]: 他們利用一種「界面活性劑」 就像肥皂分子一樣 在水裡會「自組裝」 自己乖乖排隊. (16) [Subtitle]: 形成數條極細的「圓柱狀微胞」 就像無數根隱形的「圓柱體鷹架」 接著倒入矽氧烷材料 包覆住那些微胞 形成堅固的骨架. (17) [Subtitle]: 再來是「脫模」 科學家把剛剛搭好的鷹架 也就是那些界面活性劑通通洗掉. (18) [Subtitle]: 原本鷹架佔據的位置 就變成了空腔 留下了一個由「中空管狀網路」構成的固體. (19) [Subtitle]: 最後 為了不讓這個脆弱的空心結構塌掉 他們使用「超臨界乾燥」技術 小心地把裡面液體換成空氣. (20) [Subtitle]: 結果就是一塊體積 90% 以上都是空氣 但卻是固體的透明材料. (21) [Subtitle]: 這個結構造成了一個物理奇蹟 叫做「克努森擴散」. (22) [Subtitle]: 你看 這些管子的內徑 只有不到 50 奈米 這數字很關鍵. (23) [Subtitle]: 因為空氣分子平常在傳遞熱能時 平均要跑個 60 到 70 奈米 才會撞到另一個分子. (24) [Subtitle]: 但在 MOCHI 裡面路太窄了 咬著麵包趕著上學的空氣分子還沒撞到人 就先撞壁了 把空氣原本的導熱能力直接掐斷. (25) [Subtitle]: 數據顯示 MOCHI 的熱導率 只有 10 到 12 毫瓦每米克耳文 (mW/m·K) 比「靜止的空氣」還要低. (26) [Subtitle]: 而且因為結構太整齊 透明感不輸新垣結衣 直逼葉隱透啊 穿透率超過 99% 所以科學家改叫它 凍結空氣. (27) [Subtitle]: 而且它不只是超強隔熱盾 這塊麻糍還有第二型態「熱能黑洞」. (28) [Subtitle]: MOCHI 對可見光是透明的 陽光進得來 但對於物體發出的熱輻射 也就是紅外線 它卻是強力的阻擋層 可以把熱能「只進不出」地鎖在裡面. (29) [Subtitle]: 團隊做了一個實驗 完全不用任何透鏡聚光 就只是把 MOCHI 蓋在吸熱體上曬太陽 底下的溫度竟然直接飆升到 300°C. (30) [Subtitle]: 這代表未來的窗戶 不只能隔熱 還能變成超高效率的熱水器 也可以用來驅動「熱製冷系統」 拿來發電開冷氣. (31) [Subtitle]: 目前這項技術已經申請了專利 雖然還在實驗室階段. (32) [Subtitle]: 但能把「透明」、「隔熱」跟「高溫集熱」這三個矛盾屬性結合在一起 堪稱重大突破啊. (33) [Subtitle]: 科學家表示這材料還可以用在服飾 它是軟的 可以彎曲、捲起來 而且只要薄薄一層 隔熱效果就比羽絨衣還強 非常適合極地探險或是太空衣 但記住它是透明的.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To introduce and explain a revolutionary new insulating material called MOCHI (Mesoporous Optically Clear Heat Insulator), highlighting its unique properties of being transparent, highly insulating, and heat-trapping, and discussing its potential impact on building energy efficiency and wearable technology.
